# cargo-bumpp 架构 — 计划、回滚、workspace 与 Git

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/architecture/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: cargo-bumpp 从 Cargo metadata 生成发布计划，应用版本改动，回滚本地失败，并推送一个明确的 tag。

# cargo-bumpp 架构

这是一个无依赖 Rust CLI，把发现与计划阶段和修改阶段分开，让用户在创建发布点前看到所有变化。

## 发布流水线

```text
参数 / 选择器 → cargo metadata + git history → release plan
                                               ↓ 一次确认
                         清单 + Cargo.lock ← 写入
                               ↓
                     git commit → annotated tag → 推送分支与 tag
```

## Workspace 规则

工具通过 `cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1` 识别 package、共享 workspace 版本和 path dependency。共享版本可一起升级；独立版本会被报告，只有 `--recursive` 才会分别升级。

## 回滚边界

清单写入、提交或 tag 创建失败时，工具删除本地 tag、撤销 release commit 并恢复文件快照。推送是第一个不可逆的远端动作，失败后保留本地结果并输出重试命令。

## 为什么不负责 publish？

tag 是 CI 的稳定交接点。crates.io 版本不能删除或覆盖，因此发布凭据与策略应由 CI 管理。

# cargo-bumpp CI 与发布 — 把 tag 交给自动化

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/ci-and-release/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: 说明 cargo-bumpp 如何接入 CI 发布流程、它在哪一步停止，以及远端推送失败如何重试。

# cargo-bumpp CI 与发布

`cargo-bumpp` 创建本地发布点。后续 CI 可以把 annotated tag 作为检查、打包和 registry 发布的交接事件。

## 推荐交接路径

```text
开发者或 release job
  └─ cargo bumpp --no-push  （需要时先本地检查）
       └─ commit + annotated tag
            └─ 推送分支与明确 tag
                 └─ CI 按仓库策略检查并发布
```

工具推送分支和明确 tag，而不是所有本地 tag，避免同一仓库中的无关 tag 触发发布流水线。

## CI 应负责什么？

- 测试、lint 和构建发布产物。
- crates.io 或其他 registry 的认证。
- 按策略发布包和生成 release notes。
- 记录 provenance 与部署状态。

## cargo-bumpp 明确不负责什么？

它不发布 registry、不生成 changelog，也不创建 PR 发布流程。这些行为需要仓库凭据与团队策略，不属于本地版本事务。

## 推送失败恢复

远端拒绝时保留本地 commit 和 tag。修复权限、分支保护、远端历史或网络后，执行工具打印的重试命令；如果需要重新触发流水线，再使用 `cargo bumpp --retag [tag]`。

# cargo-bumpp FAQ — 发布流程、Cargo workspace 与对比

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/faq/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: 回答 cargo-bumpp 关于发布、changelog、回滚、workspace、retag 以及相似工具的问题。

# cargo-bumpp FAQ

## cargo-bumpp 会发布到 crates.io 吗？

不会。它止步于提交与 tag，CI 可以以 tag 作为发布触发点。

## 会生成 changelog 吗？

不会。changelog 不属于核心的升级、提交、tag、推送路径。

## 和 cargo-release 有什么区别？

`cargo-release` 覆盖更完整的发布工作流，依赖更多；`cargo-bumpp` 聚焦零依赖的交互式发布点，不负责 registry publish。

## 和 cargo-bump 有什么区别？

`cargo-bumpp` 还提供交互选择器、workspace 与 path dependency 处理、计划展示、推送前回滚、提交和 tag，以及 retag 流程。

## `conventional` 做什么？

它读取上一个可达 tag 之后的提交历史，判断 major、minor 或 patch；默认最多查看 100 条提交。

## 推送失败会怎样？

本地提交与 tag 会保留，工具会打印 Git 错误和重试命令。

## 可以在 cargo-bumpp 仓库里运行吗？

可以。仓库提供开发用 Cargo alias，能直接运行工作树版本；其他目录可安装发布 crate，或执行 `cargo install --path .`。

# cargo-bumpp 快速开始 — 安装并完成第一次升级

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/getting-started/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: 安装 cargo-bumpp，运行交互式或明确版本升级，查看计划并控制提交、tag 与推送。

# cargo-bumpp 快速开始

默认流程会显示选择、打印计划、等待一次确认，然后创建提交、tag 与定向推送。

## 1. 安装

```bash
cargo install cargo-bumpp
cargo bumpp --help
bumpp --help
```

需要 Rust 1.74+，并且 `cargo` 与 `git` 在 `PATH` 中。支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。

## 2. 第一次升级

交互选择：

```bash
cargo bumpp
```

明确升级 patch：

```bash
cargo bumpp patch
```

指定版本并暂不推送：

```bash
cargo bumpp 1.0.0 --no-push
```

在已有自动化确认的场景跳过最终确认：

```bash
cargo bumpp minor -y
```

## 3. 控制边界

只改版本号：

```bash
cargo bumpp --no-tag --no-push
```

重新创建最近的 tag 并强推：

```bash
cargo bumpp --retag
```

第一次使用建议加 `--no-push`，先检查本地提交和 tag。

## 4. 失败时会怎样？

清单、lockfile、提交和 tag 被视为一个本地事务。推送前失败会回滚；推送失败会保留本地提交和 tag，并打印重试命令。

# cargo-bumpp 参考手册 — 升级级别、flags 与退出码

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/reference/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: cargo-bumpp 的命令、升级级别、flags、配置优先级和进程退出码参考。

# cargo-bumpp 参考手册

## 调用方式

```bash
cargo bumpp [release]
bumpp [release]
```

Cargo 子命令和直接二进制使用同一个 release engine。版本可以交互选择、使用级别名称，或直接给出明确版本。

## 升级值

支持 `major`、`minor`、`patch`、`next`、`conventional`、`conventional-prerelease`、`premajor`、`preminor`、`prepatch`、`prerelease`、`as-is`、`prompt`，以及 `1.2.3` 这样的明确版本。版本允许带 `v` 前缀。

## 常用 flags

| Flag | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `--release <level>` | 明确升级级别或版本。 |
| `--retag [tag]` | 重建已有 tag 并强推。 |
| `--preid <id>` | 设置预发布标识，默认 `beta`。 |
| `-y, --yes` | 跳过最终确认。 |
| `-p, --push` / `--no-push` | 开启或关闭远端推送。 |
| `-t, --tag [name]` / `--no-tag` | 创建或跳过 tag，可使用模板。 |
| `-c, --commit [message]` / `--no-commit` | 创建或跳过 release commit。 |
| `-r, --recursive` | 分别升级独立 workspace 成员。 |
| `--no-sign` | 覆盖 Git 的提交和 tag 签名配置。 |
| `-x, --execute <command>` | 写版本后、提交前执行命令。 |
| `--current-version <version>` | 覆盖自动探测的当前版本。 |
| `--print-commits` / `--no-print-commits` | 显示或隐藏 `conventional` 使用的提交。 |
| `--lockfile` / `--no-lockfile` | 执行或跳过 `cargo update --workspace`。 |
| `--commit-window <n>` | 限制 `conventional` 读取的提交数，默认 100。 |
| `--configFilePath <path>` | 使用其他 `bumpp.toml` 路径。 |
| `-q, --quiet` | 只输出警告和错误。 |

短选项遵循 `bumpp` 习惯：`-r` 是 recursive，`-p` 是 push。

## 配置优先级

支持的设置按命令行、环境变量、`bumpp.toml`、内置默认值排序。`--execute` 等执行命令的选项必须放在命令行。

## 退出码

| 代码 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | 成功完成。 |
| `1` | 检查或发布步骤失败，能回滚时已恢复本地状态。 |
| `2` | 用法或配置错误。 |
| `130` | 用户在提示处取消。 |

# cargo-bumpp 故障排查 — Git、签名、提示与 workspace

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/troubleshooting/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: 解决 cargo-bumpp 工作树、GPG 签名、非交互终端、workspace 版本和远端推送问题。

# cargo-bumpp 故障排查

## 工作树不干净

默认 Git 检查会保护计划之外的改动。先提交或 stash；只有明确接受风险时才使用 `--no-git-check`。

## GPG 签名阻塞发布

即使没有传 `--sign`，Git 配置也可能要求提交或 tag 签名。如果本次不需要签名，使用 `--no-sign`；如果需要签名，先检查密钥、agent 和 PIN 配置。

## 选择器或确认读不到输入

在交互终端直接给升级级别，例如 `cargo bumpp patch`。自动化中提供级别和 `-y`，并在允许 push 前保留 CI 自己的审批门槛。

## workspace 成员版本不同

阅读计划中的成员列表。如果独立版本是有意设计，使用 `--recursive`；如果应该共享一个版本，先整理清单再升级。

## 推送失败

本地 commit 和 tag 会保留。修复权限、分支保护、远端历史或网络后，执行工具打印的重试命令，不要因为 push 被拒就重新生成一个版本。

## Retag 找不到目标

先抓取 tag 并确认它存在：

```bash
git fetch --tags
cargo bumpp --retag v1.2.3 --no-push
```

重新创建或移动 tag 前，目标 tag 必须已经存在于本地仓库。

# cargo-bumpp workspace 与回滚 — 版本、metadata 和恢复

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/cargo-bumpp/workspace-and-rollback/
Language: zh-CN
Project: cargo-bumpp
Description: 说明 cargo-bumpp 如何发现 Cargo workspace 版本、处理 path dependency，并在发布步骤失败时恢复本地状态。

# cargo-bumpp workspace 与回滚

## metadata 发现

工具读取 `cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1` 获取 package 成员、workspace 版本和 path dependency，不只根据文件名猜项目图。

## 共享 workspace 版本

成员使用共享 workspace 版本时，一次升级可以同步修改共享 package 和依赖声明。计划会打印每个清单位置，方便检查具体变化。

## 独立成员版本

多个成员有不同版本且未使用 recursive 时，cargo-bumpp 会报告不一致，而不是静默跳过。使用 `--recursive` 才会按成员自己的版本分别升级。

## path dependency 版本

path dependency 可能带有需要随 workspace 一起变化的版本要求。计划会包含这些变化，因此发布前必须读取 Cargo metadata。

## 本地事务

```text
快照 → 写清单/lockfile → commit → tag
  └─ push 前失败 → 删除 tag、撤销 commit、恢复文件
```

推送在回滚边界之外。远端拒绝不会删除本地发布点，工具会给出准确的重试命令。

## Retag

`--retag` 是独立操作：把已有 tag 重新创建到目标 commit 并强推，不升级版本、不写文件、不创建新 commit。

# triggerix architecture

The project defines a portable schema boundary so producers can describe triggers without binding the event model to one runtime or language.

# triggerix 架构

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/triggerix/architecture/
Language: zh-CN
Project: triggerix
Description: triggerix 的运行边界、包职责和设计事实。

# triggerix 架构

The project defines a portable schema boundary so producers can describe triggers without binding the event model to one runtime or language.

## 边界图

~~~text
用户或调用方
        │
        ▼
triggerix 运行边界
        │
        ├─ 项目专属实现
        ├─ 测试与 fixtures
        └─ 构建或发布产物
~~~

具体模块名和包图以当前仓库版本为准。先从 README 和源码入口开始，再沿 import 进入实现边界。

## 应该检查什么？

| 区域 | 问题 |
| --- | --- |
| 入口 | 哪个命令、包、应用或 API 启动项目？ |
| 数据边界 | 哪些输入进入项目，哪些输出离开项目？ |
| 运行边界 | 哪些工作发生在浏览器、CLI、本机进程或服务中？ |
| 失败边界 | 哪些错误返回调用方，哪些会重试或记录？ |
| 发布边界 | 哪些产物会构建、发布或交给后续流程？ |

# triggerix 快速开始

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/triggerix/getting-started/
Language: zh-CN
Project: triggerix
Description: 从源仓库安装并运行 triggerix，完成第一次本地验证。

# triggerix 快速开始

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/triggerix-collective/triggerix.git
cd triggerix
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the repository, install its workspace dependencies, and read the root README before choosing a package to build.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

# Synra architecture

The monorepo separates product applications, shared packages, and runtime integrations so the platform can evolve without putting every concern in one frontend.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
Synra runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

| Area | Question |
| --- | --- |

| Data boundary | What inputs enter the project and what outputs leave it? |
| Runtime boundary | Which work happens in the browser, CLI, native process, or service? |
| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

# Synra getting started

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/synra/getting-started/
Language: en
Project: synra
Description: Install and run Synra from its source repository, then verify the first local workflow.

# Get started with Synra

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/synra-app/synra.git
cd synra
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the repository, install workspace dependencies, and use the repository scripts to select the application you want to run.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

# flash-tunnel architecture

| 发布边界 | 哪些产物会构建、发布或交给后续流程？ |

# harbor architecture

Project: harbor
Description: Runtime boundaries, package roles, and design facts for harbor.

# harbor architecture

Harbor treats a workspace release as a graph and policy problem: inspect members, calculate an order, preflight the tag, then execute the allowed release actions.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
harbor runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

| Runtime boundary | Which work happens in the browser, CLI, native process, or service? |
| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

# harbor getting started

# Get started with harbor

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/harbor.git
cd harbor
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the Rust repository and build the workspace with Cargo before trying a release workflow.

~~~bash
cargo build --workspace
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

Project: bigseek-js

# bigseek-js architecture

The client loads a compact index in the browser, uses the WebAssembly query engine when available, and can fall back to a JavaScript search path.

它适合需要这个项目所描述能力的用户或开发者。支持的工作流和当前版本行为以仓库 README 为准。

## 如何开始？

克隆 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/crate-plugin-kit)，阅读 README，安装声明的工具链，然后运行[快速开始](/zh/projects/crate-plugin-kit/getting-started)中的最小验证命令。

## 有公开文档站吗？

当前项目清单中没有确认到已部署的文档域名，应以仓库 README 和源文档为准。

## 出错时先检查什么？

先检查运行时版本、包管理器、生成产物，以及 README 中的准确命令，再对照测试和 issue 信息定位问题。

## 事实来源在哪里？

[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/crate-plugin-kit)

本 FAQ 只描述 crate-plugin-kit，不会把其他项目的假设混进来。

~~~

# npm-plugin-kit architecture

Language: en
Project: npm-plugin-kit
Description: Runtime boundaries, package roles, and design facts for npm-plugin-kit.

# npm-plugin-kit architecture

The package manager is the distribution boundary: a host resolves plugin packages and loads the exported capability through a stable contract.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
npm-plugin-kit runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

## What to inspect

| Area | Question |
| --- | --- |
| Entry point | Which command, package, app, or API starts the project? |
| Data boundary | What inputs enter the project and what outputs leave it? |
| Runtime boundary | Which work happens in the browser, CLI, native process, or service? |
| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

# Get started with npm-plugin-kit

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash

cd npm-plugin-kit
~~~

Clone the repository, install workspace dependencies, and read the Quick Start before creating a plugin package.

~~~bash

~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

# spotlight getting started

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/spotlight/getting-started/
Language: en
Project: spotlight

# Get started with spotlight

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/spotlight.git
cd spotlight
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the Rust workspace, build the overlay, and inspect the example flow before connecting an agent.

~~~bash
cargo build --workspace
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

Description: 从源仓库安装并运行 qmd-server，完成第一次本地验证。

# qmd-server 快速开始

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/qmd-server.git
cd qmd-server
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the repository, install dependencies, and inspect the server entrypoint and environment variables before starting it.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

# fs-ctx architecture

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/fs-ctx.git
cd fs-ctx
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the library, install dependencies, and run its tests before using the context adapter in another process.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

- [项目总览](/zh/projects/fs-ctx/)
- [架构](/zh/projects/fs-ctx/architecture)
- [FAQ](/zh/projects/fs-ctx/faq)

# ext-kit architecture

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/ext-kit/architecture/
Language: en
Project: ext-kit
Description: Runtime boundaries, package roles, and design facts for ext-kit.

# ext-kit architecture

The toolkit packages repeatable extension concerns such as storage, messaging, and context boundaries so product extensions can share tested primitives.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
ext-kit runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

## What to inspect

| Area | Question |
| --- | --- |
| Entry point | Which command, package, app, or API starts the project? |
| Data boundary | What inputs enter the project and what outputs leave it? |
| Runtime boundary | Which work happens in the browser, CLI, native process, or service? |
| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

- [FAQ](/projects/ext-kit/faq)

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash

~~~

# unplugin-build-stamp architecture

The plugin reads build metadata at bundler time and exposes stable constants to application code without making runtime Git calls.

        │
        ▼

        │

        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts

git clone https://github.com/imba97/unplugin-build-stamp.git
cd unplugin-build-stamp
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the package, install dependencies, and run the test suite before adding the plugin to a bundler configuration.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

## 继续阅读

- [项目总览](/zh/projects/unplugin-build-stamp/)
- [架构](/zh/projects/unplugin-build-stamp/architecture)
- [FAQ](/zh/projects/unplugin-build-stamp/faq)

[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/unplugin-build-stamp) 是版本相关安装说明的来源。

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/picgo-plugin-ftp-uploader.git
cd picgo-plugin-ftp-uploader
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the plugin, install dependencies, and read the configuration keys in the README before registering it with PicGo.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

# simple-sftp-uploader FAQ

## simple-sftp-uploader 是什么？

与 bundler 无关的插件，用于通过 SFTP 把项目 dist 上传到远端服务器。

## 适合谁？

它适合需要这个项目所描述能力的用户或开发者。支持的工作流和当前版本行为以仓库 README 为准。

## 如何开始？

克隆 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/simple-sftp-uploader)，阅读 README，安装声明的工具链，然后运行[快速开始](/zh/projects/simple-sftp-uploader/getting-started)中的最小验证命令。

## 有公开文档站吗？

当前项目清单中没有确认到已部署的文档域名，应以仓库 README 和源文档为准。

## 出错时先检查什么？

先检查运行时版本、包管理器、生成产物，以及 README 中的准确命令，再对照测试和 issue 信息定位问题。

## 事实来源在哪里？

[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/simple-sftp-uploader)

本 FAQ 只描述 simple-sftp-uploader，不会把其他项目的假设混进来。

# simple-sftp-uploader 快速开始

# simple-sftp-uploader 快速开始

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/simple-sftp-uploader.git
cd simple-sftp-uploader
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the plugin, install dependencies, and add it to the bundler used by the project you want to deploy.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

A markdown-it extension for typed inline links such as {link:post:123}. This page is the independent overview for this project: it records the project identity, intended use, runtime boundary, and links to the detailed pages below.

- The project has a focused scope: a markdown-it extension for typed inline links such as {link:post:123}.
- Its implementation and release behavior are defined by the [repository README](https://github.com/imba97/markdown-it-extra-link#readme), source tree, tests, and release metadata.
- The project can be understood and cited without importing facts from another project.

# markdown-it-extra-link architecture

The parser extension recognizes typed link syntax and delegates the final URL resolution to the host application.

A markdown-it extension for typed inline links such as {link:post:123}.

It is for users or developers who need the specific capability described by this project. The repository README defines the supported workflow and current release behavior.

No deployed documentation URL has been verified in the current project inventory. Use the repository README and source documentation as the current authority.

Check the runtime version, package manager, generated artifacts, and the exact command from the repository README. Then compare the failure with the project's tests and issue tracker before changing code.

# Get started with markdown-it-extra-link

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/markdown-it-extra-link.git
cd markdown-it-extra-link
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the package, install dependencies, and read the parser examples before adding the plugin to a Markdown pipeline.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

# hexo-unocss architecture

The plugin connects Hexo rendering with UnoCSS generation so article content can use utility classes without moving to a different site generator.

        ▼

        └─ build or release artifacts

它适合需要这个项目所描述能力的用户或开发者。支持的工作流和当前版本行为以仓库 README 为准。

## 如何开始？

克隆 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/lodash-imports)，阅读 README，安装声明的工具链，然后运行[快速开始](/zh/projects/lodash-imports/getting-started)中的最小验证命令。

## 有公开文档站吗？

当前项目清单中没有确认到已部署的文档域名，应以仓库 README 和源文档为准。

## 出错时先检查什么？

先检查运行时版本、包管理器、生成产物，以及 README 中的准确命令，再对照测试和 issue 信息定位问题。

## 事实来源在哪里？

[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/lodash-imports)

本 FAQ 只描述 lodash-imports，不会把其他项目的假设混进来。

# charbi-font 快速开始

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/zh/projects/charbi-font/getting-started/
Language: zh-CN
Project: charbi-font
Description: 从源仓库安装并运行 charbi-font，完成第一次本地验证。

# charbi-font 快速开始

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/charbi-font.git
cd charbi-font
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the tool, install dependencies, and run it against a small fixture before using it in a production build.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

## 继续阅读

- [项目总览](/zh/projects/charbi-font/)
- [架构](/zh/projects/charbi-font/architecture)
- [FAQ](/zh/projects/charbi-font/faq)

[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/imba97/charbi-font) 是版本相关安装说明的来源。

# nano-pastel

<p class="lead"><strong>nano-pastel</strong> is a parity-alternating pastel palette generator with hash-stable colors.</p>

Maintainer: [imba97](/about).

## What is nano-pastel?

A parity-alternating pastel palette generator with hash-stable colors. This page is the independent overview for this project: it records the project identity, intended use, runtime boundary, and links to the detailed pages below.

## Identity

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | nano-pastel |
| Category | Color utility |
| Runtime | TypeScript |
| Repository | [GitHub](https://github.com/imba97/nano-pastel) |

## What it covers

- The project has a focused scope: a parity-alternating pastel palette generator with hash-stable colors.
- Its implementation and release behavior are defined by the [repository README](https://github.com/imba97/nano-pastel#readme), source tree, tests, and release metadata.
- The project can be understood and cited without importing facts from another project.

## Continue with this project

- [Architecture](/projects/nano-pastel/architecture) — understand the runtime boundary and package roles.
- [FAQ](/projects/nano-pastel/faq) — answer common intent and scope questions.

The repository is the source of truth for version-specific commands. This overview intentionally describes only nano-pastel.

# nano-pastel architecture

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/nano-pastel/architecture/
Language: en
Project: nano-pastel
Description: Runtime boundaries, package roles, and design facts for nano-pastel.

# nano-pastel architecture

The generator maps stable input values to palette groups while keeping adjacent groups visually separated.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
nano-pastel runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

| Area | Question |
| --- | --- |
| Entry point | Which command, package, app, or API starts the project? |
| Data boundary | What inputs enter the project and what outputs leave it? |
| Runtime boundary | Which work happens in the browser, CLI, native process, or service? |
| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

# nano-pastel FAQ

## What is nano-pastel?

A parity-alternating pastel palette generator with hash-stable colors.

## Who is it for?

It is for users or developers who need the specific capability described by this project. The repository README defines the supported workflow and current release behavior.

## How do I start?

Clone [the GitHub repository](https://github.com/imba97/nano-pastel), read its README, install the declared toolchain, and run the smallest verification command shown in [Getting started](/projects/nano-pastel/getting-started).

## Is there a public documentation site?

No deployed documentation URL has been verified in the current project inventory. Use the repository README and source documentation as the current authority.

## What should I check when something fails?

Check the runtime version, package manager, generated artifacts, and the exact command from the repository README. Then compare the failure with the project's tests and issue tracker before changing code.

## Where is the source of truth?

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/imba97/nano-pastel)

This FAQ describes only nano-pastel; it does not merge assumptions from other projects.

Project: nano-pastel
Description: Install and run nano-pastel from its source repository, then verify the first local workflow.

# Get started with nano-pastel

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/nano-pastel.git
cd nano-pastel
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the package, install dependencies, and run the examples to inspect stable output for repeated inputs.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/uni-routefinity.git
cd uni-routefinity
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the package, install dependencies, and run the route examples in a uni-app test project.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

- The project has a focused scope: a vite+ monorepo starter for web, capacitor, and electron applications.
- Its implementation and release behavior are defined by the [repository README](https://github.com/imba97/cross-craft#readme), source tree, tests, and release metadata.
- The project can be understood and cited without importing facts from another project.

# cross-craft architecture

The starter separates shared packages from platform applications so web and desktop targets can reuse the same product code.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
cross-craft runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

## What to inspect

| Area | Question |
| --- | --- |
| Entry point | Which command, package, app, or API starts the project? |
| Data boundary | What inputs enter the project and what outputs leave it? |
| Runtime boundary | Which work happens in the browser, CLI, native process, or service? |
| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

# cross-craft getting started

Language: en
Project: cross-craft

# Get started with cross-craft

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/cross-craft.git
cd cross-craft
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the starter, install workspace dependencies, and choose the target application before running the development script.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

# Get started with bilibili-toy-starter

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash

cd bilibili-toy-starter
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the starter, install dependencies, and start the development app before adding creator API calls.

~~~bash

~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。

# Get started with h2l-ranking

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.

# Btools-vue getting started

Project: btools-vue

# Get started with Btools-vue

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/imba97/Btools-vue.git
cd btools-vue
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the extension, install dependencies, and load the development build as an unpacked browser extension.

~~~bash
pnpm install
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

## What is yyds-lang?

A YYDS language monorepo with grammar, AST, lexer, parser, semantic analysis, language service, and editor tooling. This page is the independent overview for this project: it records the project identity, intended use, runtime boundary, and links to the detailed pages below.
A verified documentation entry point is available at [https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds/tree/main/docs](https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds/tree/main/docs).

## What it covers

- The project has a focused scope: a yyds language monorepo with grammar, ast, lexer, parser, semantic analysis, language service, and editor tooling.
- Its implementation and release behavior are defined by the [repository README](https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds#readme), source tree, tests, and release metadata.
- The project can be understood and cited without importing facts from another project.

# yyds-lang architecture

The workspace separates language packages from the Web Studio application, with a Web Worker and Go WebAssembly runtime for browser execution.

## Boundary map

~~~text
user or calling application
        │
        ▼
yyds-lang runtime boundary
        │
        ├─ project-specific implementation
        ├─ tests and fixtures
        └─ build or release artifacts
~~~

The exact module names and package graph belong to the repository version being used. Start with the README and source entrypoints, then follow imports into the implementation boundary.

| Failure boundary | Which errors are returned to the caller and which are retried or logged? |
| Release boundary | Which artifacts are built, published, or handed to another workflow? |

## What is yyds-lang?

# yyds-lang getting started

URL: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/yyds-lang/getting-started/
Language: en
Project: yyds-lang

# Get started with yyds-lang

The safest first run starts from the canonical repository and follows the project's own package or workspace scripts.

## 1. Clone the repository

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds.git
cd yyds-lang
~~~

## 2. Install or build the runtime

Clone the workspace, install dependencies, and use the website app or package-level scripts described in the README.

~~~bash
vp run website#dev
~~~

If the repository uses a different package manager, toolchain, or platform SDK, use its README as the version-specific authority before changing the command.

## 3. Verify locally

- Read the root README and package metadata.
- Run the smallest test, build, or help command available.
- Keep generated output separate from source files.
- Record the runtime version when reproducing a problem.

# yyds-lang 快速开始

第一次运行应从 canonical 仓库开始，并按照项目自己的 package 或 workspace 脚本执行。

## 1. 克隆仓库

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds.git
cd yyds-lang
~~~

## 2. 安装或构建运行环境

Clone the workspace, install dependencies, and use the website app or package-level scripts described in the README.

~~~bash
vp run website#dev
~~~

如果仓库声明了其他包管理器、工具链或平台 SDK，应以 README 中的版本要求为准。

## 3. 本地验证

- 阅读根目录 README 和包元数据。
- 先运行最小的测试、构建或 help 命令。
- 把生成物与源码分开。
- 复现问题时记录运行时版本。
